title: Zero Watt
summary: Battery power monitor for Cardputer Zero with a live watt curve and history
description: Reads real BQ27220 battery data at configurable 100–60000 ms intervals. Includes live power curves, cursor-centered history zoom, A/B range energy analysis, independent measurement sessions, and page-specific keyboard help.

zh-CN.summary: 适用于 Cardputer Zero 的电池功率监视器，带实时功率曲线和全屏历史页
zh-CN.description: 每秒读取 BQ27220 的电压、电流、电量和温度，显示带符号的充放电功率、净平均值、60 秒实时曲线和可缩放的全屏历史页。
